Little is known about '''Vexxtal Crystals''' or their origins. They are generally only found in the [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsabers]] of [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]] of [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] users. A corrupting aura is left on those wounded by lightsabers with this crystal.

==Behind the scenes==
An interview with [[W. Haden Blackman]] indicated that this crystal is all that's left of "Force Plague," a power cut from the final version of [[Star Wars: The Force Unleashed|''The Force Unleashed'']].<ref>{{WebCite|url=http://kotaku.com/5056815/a-talk-with-lucasarts-on-plagues-reviews-and-internal-development|text=A Talk with LucasArts: On Plagues, Reviews and Internal Development|author=Brian Crecente|date=2008-10-03|archivedate=20081004232749}}</ref>
